register.title: Amund Kristiansen's n303 dilation certificate at 511f56b, issue755
register.headline: Kristiansen's n303 packing, found from Daniel's T-230, certified exactly
register.source_checks: The author reports that Evan Daniel's two exact rational checkers at evand/square-packing 7982d7a, verify_cert.py (separating axes) and verify_cert2.py (polygon intersection), accept the certificate, with least wall clearance 8.2e-13 and least pair separation 1.2e-12 over 724 close pairs, and that a third, unpublished exact check (a local packing workbench's rational certifier on the float packing) accepts it too; the issue says the two public checkers share an author and the certificate format, which also made the certificate. The source states the certificate is a dilation of a binary64 packing made with Daniel's search/packer/dilate_cert.py: centres and box scaled by 1 + 10^-12, coordinates rounded to rationals and each angle to a rational half-angle tangent, so every square is exactly unit; it certifies the upper bound only, and states no exact KKT solve, local-optimality or rigidity analysis. It calls the packing new, found from Daniel's registered packing (#728), not a refinement of it (largest move 0.547, 12 squares beyond 0.1, 96 tilted squares against 91). Those are the source's statements. No source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Amund Kristiansen (https://gist.github.com/amundsk/78f9f0e7b4669f2f509a281845081768), whose search started from Evan Daniel's registered packing at 303 (#728, found from Daniil Ostashev's packing), perturbed it in float32 batches and polished the best variants with Daniel's fq quench, as the issue says; the certificate was made with Daniel's dilate_cert.py and checked with his checkers. The search, the certificate and the request were done by Claude (Anthropic) in Claude Code at Amund Kristiansen's direction.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay (stage 4, think-tqb5); once at V3/C3, adopt at 303 and regularize.

bibliography.note: One complete exact dilation certificate in the gist amundsk/78f9f0e7b4669f2f509a281845081768 at 511f56bf6e6afb4eb22f12d31371c2a2fe7b4767, s(303) <= 223872029093440709529093216833/(125*10^26), found by a perturb-and-polish search from Evan Daniel's #728 packing (W-known-best-n303) with Daniel's fq quench, dilate_cert.py and checkers. Measured pose by pose in the packet (measure/identity.json), it pairs one to one with T-230's packing, 12 squares beyond a tenth and 96 tilted squares against 91: a new arrangement near T-230's, not a refinement of it. Derived exact fact only; no upstream byte is retained. Claude assistance disclosed. No local or global optimality claim.
